tasks.goal: Patrol the Charter Hall perimeter, pausing at each exhibit node so charter displays can be read and logged.
tasks.terrain: Compacted gravel pathways along the Echo Point cliff edge; keep 2 m clearance from sandstone escarpment drop above Jamison Valley.
success: No obstacle-stop events on gravel slopes < 15 deg
safety_stops: E-stop if within 1.5 m of cliff edge line
Stop on tilt > 20 deg
Stop on LiDAR obstacle < 0.5 m
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms the patrol route file before each session.

tasks.goal: Traverse lab shelving, scan research binder spines and place a summary printout in the steward inbox.
tasks.terrain: Flat timber floor; low lab stools and cable runs as ground clutter; eucalypt-scented humidity noted only for sensor logging.
success: Scan >= 20 binder labels with > 95% OCR confidence
safety_stops: Stop arm if force torque > 15 N
Base stop if obstacle < 0.3 m
Abort pick if gripper slip detected twice
tasks.human_in_loop: A person verifies scanned evidence summaries before filing to the evidence base.

tasks.goal: Carry printed proposal drafts from the drafting table to the human voting desks between decision cycles.
tasks.terrain: Slightly uneven sandstone-paved forum floor with mist-slick patches at dawn; low bench seating as obstacles.
success: No slip-induced falls (all foot contacts > 90% of stride)
safety_stops: Stop if ToF obstacle < 0.4 m
Sit down if IMU detects pitch > 30 deg
Release-carry alert if payload sensor reports tilt
tasks.human_in_loop: Stewards open and debate the drafts; agents never enact proposals.

tasks.goal: Inspect task-routing consoles and cabling across the tiered deck, reading status LEDs and thermal markers.
tasks.terrain: Tiered timber deck stairs (3 steps, 18 cm rise) and under-desk cable trays; morning valley mist may condense on decking.
success: Inspect 6 consoles with legible LED reads
safety_stops: Stop if stair edge detected within 0.2 m of footfall
Stop on condensation slip (foot force variance spike)
Auto-dock if battery < 20%
tasks.human_in_loop: A coordinator approves the inspection checklist and receives flagged anomalies.

tasks.goal: Fly a slow indoor hover circuit over the progress board, capturing per-zone outcome chart imagery for the tracker agent.
tasks.terrain: Calm indoor air; open observation windows admit sunrise updrafts and mist from the Jamison Valley, gusts under 2 m/s.
success: >= 90% sharp chart frames (blur metric below threshold)
safety_stops: Land if gust > 2.5 m/s
Land if range sensor reads < 0.4 m to any surface
Failsafe land on pose estimate loss > 1 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A person confirms flight clearance and reviews captured chart images.

tasks.goal: Stand at the charter display, point to each mission clause and read it aloud for visitor sessions, then bow to the human stewards.
tasks.terrain: Level polished floor of the hall entrance; avoid the stone plinth base of the charter display (0.6 m radius).
success: Complete 5 clause gestures within 5 cm pointing accuracy
Whole-body balance maintained (CoP inside support polygon)
Speech aligned to gestures within 0.5 s
safety_stops: Stop if ankle F/T imbalance > threshold
Sit-protect if push detected > 20 N
Abort if plinth proximity < 0.5 m
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward opens and closes each demo session and may halt it at any time.

tasks.goal: Mount at the evidence shelf, sort scanned research binders into topic slots flagged by the Evidence Monitor agent.
tasks.terrain: Fixed bench next to shelf wall; binder weight up to 1.5 kg; no floor hazards (static cell).
safety_stops: Joint stop if torque > 80% rating
Release if slip detected
Speed reduce to 250 mm/s if steward enters cell
tasks.human_in_loop: A person validates the topic-to-slot mapping before automated sorting begins.

tasks.goal: Mounted at the observatory rail, use the arm to seed native eucalypt seedlings into trays for the bush-regeneration outcome metric.
tasks.terrain: Arm fixed to observation railing; wind gusts over the open valley; trays on a 15 deg sloped shelf.
success: Place >= 12 seedlings upright in tray cells
No dropped seedlings over the rail
safety_stops: Stop if wrist F/T exceeds limit in gusts
Pause if wind sensor > 5 m/s
Retract if rail vibration exceeds threshold
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms the planting schedule and accepts the regeneration count.
